_comment: The only file to edit by hand once the products exist on Gumroad: paste each product's link (Gumroad > Products > Share, e.g. https://tornanti.gumroad.com/l/agnello) into 'checkout'. An empty checkout shows the product as 'in arrivo'. Prices are in euro and must match the ones set on Gumroad, which adds VAT for the buyer's country at checkout.
